data.name: Mafia Boss Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Step into the dangerous and glamorous underworld of 1930s New York in Mafia Boss Simulator, a gripping third-person simulation game built in Unreal Engine. You’re a streetwise outsider with big ambition — now it’s time to rise through the ranks and claim your place at the top of the criminal empire.

Build your crew. Bribe the cops. Run illegal rackets. Control speakeasies, gambling dens, and underground trade. But beware — every move has consequences, and rival families are always watching. Can you outsmart, outgun, and outlast them all to become the city’s most feared Mafia Boss?

From back-alley brawls to high-stakes deals in smoky jazz clubs, every choice shapes your rise to power. Will you rule with fear or loyalty? Blood or business?

data.short_description: They shot you on your own driveway. Now dig your way back. MAFIA BOSS SIMULATOR is a cinematic crime saga from 1920s Sicily to 1950s New York — stealth, driving, shootouts, and a story of loyalty, betrayal, and the price of the crown. Welcome to the Family.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mafia Boss Simulator is a cinematic crime drama set in the 
1920s–1950s American underworld. Intended for mature audiences.

⚠️ Violence: Frequent gun combat with period weapons (pistols, 
Tommy Guns, shotguns). Blood effects, melee takedowns, and 
scripted close-range executions of disarmed enemies. Cutscenes 
depict characters being shot and killed.

⚠️ Criminal Themes: The player is a criminal. Missions include 
theft, smuggling, bootlegging, assassination, intimidation, 
police bribery, and a prison escape.

⚠️ Language: Strong profanity and period-appropriate threatening 
dialogue.

⚠️ Alcohol & Tobacco: Frequent depictions of drinking, smoking, 
speakeasies, and Prohibition-era bootlegging.

⚠️ Mature Themes: Betrayal, grief, wrongful imprisonment, revenge, 
and death of allies. One scene shows a character preparing to 
hang another (interrupted, not shown on screen).
